mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO DIS_PROD_PARTNER CPR USING (
SELECT #{item.prodPartenerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_PARTENER_ID, #{item.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{item.partnerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PARTNER_NAME, #{item.effDate,jdbcType=DATE} EFF_DATE, #{item.effEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} EFF_END_DATE, #{item.dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_STATUS, #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_SOURCE, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON(CPR.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID AND CPR.EFF_DATE = TEMP.EFF_DATE AND CPR.EFF_END_DATE = TEMP.EFF_END_DATE AND CPR.DATA_STATUS = TEMP.DATA_STATUS )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CPR.PROD_PARTENER_ID = TEMP.PROD_PARTENER_ID, CPR.PARTNER_NAME = TEMP.PARTNER_NAME, CPR.DATA_SOURCE = TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, CPR.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CPR.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CPR.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CPR.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CPR.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_PARTENER_ID, PROD_ID, PARTNER_NAME, EFF_DATE, EFF_END_DATE, DATA_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT ) VALUES(TEMP.PROD_PARTENER_ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.PARTNER_NAME, TEMP.EFF_DATE, TEMP.EFF_END_DATE, TEMP.DATA_STATUS, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
